en: The Section on the Training Rules (Sekhiyakaṇḍa)
The Training Rule on Licking the Hands.
At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, the group-of-six monks were licking their hands while eating.
… [as before] … “The training is to be observed: ‘I shall not eat by licking my hands.
One must not eat by licking one’s hands.”
Whoever, out of disrespect, eats by licking his hands commits an offense of wrong-doing (dukkaṭa).
There is no offense if it was unintentional … [and so forth] …
"For one who is a first offender":
the second training rule is concluded.
